explanationMd: Use common denominator 2x: 1/x=2/(2x). Adding 1/(2x) yields 3/(2x). The nonzero condition ensures both original fractions are defined.

distractorRationale.e: This combines denominators without preserving values.
distractorRationale.c: This incorrectly moves the denominator coefficient 2 into the numerator and combines the two x factors as if multiplying; addition instead requires a common denominator.
